one_line: A local-first debugger for NPC beliefs, rumor provenance, and canon-change fallout.
what_it_does: Lets narrative game developers and agents inspect belief state, trace rumors, evaluate conditions, stage edits, and apply page-reviewed patches with receipts.
leverage_rationale: Structured belief, provenance, condition, staging, and review-bound commit operations materially improve precision and repeatability over UI-driving automation.
leverage_evidence: Five narrow WebMCP tools share the live belief and canon state.
Demo claim centers on staged page-reviewed patches and a 1→1→0 condition-fallout workflow.
execution_rationale: The packet describes a coherent end-to-end debugger with deterministic calculations, review state, and receipts; the submitted video evidence is authoritative but lacks transcript detail.
execution_evidence: Three submitted video frame sheets show the product workflow.
Description specifies pending_page_review, revision/fingerprint binding, approved-operation commit, and receipt output.
impact_rationale: Narrative game developers have a specific, costly consistency problem, and the product addresses subtle canon and belief regressions rather than only presenting a dashboard.
impact_evidence: Concrete traveller_stay and warehouse_dispute fallout example.
Preserves incorrect beliefs and rumor provenance while repairing conditions.
creativity_rationale: Applying WebMCP to narrative belief-state debugging and explainable canon fallout is a fresh, deeply domain-specific interaction model.
creativity_evidence: Belief/rumor provenance is treated as inspectable game-world state.
The product exposes approval decisions and causal fallout as first-class workflow concepts.
usability_note: The shared page review and explicit receipts suggest strong safety and inspectability, though the workflow is specialized.
standouts: Excellent domain fit for structured agent operations.
Strong safety model for world-state edits.
advance_reason: High-leverage, unusually specific developer workflow with credible end-to-end evidence.

one_line: A human-in-the-loop shopping assistant for verified product comparison and accessible voice-first decisions.
what_it_does: Searches live Shopify products through structured tools, explains trade-offs, proposes shortlist and cart actions, and keeps the shopper in control.
leverage_rationale: WebMCP makes product facts, shared shopping state, and safe cart proposals structured and verifiable instead of relying on brittle scraping and invented results.
leverage_evidence: Thirteen tools expose visible shopping state, verified search, results, and safe cart actions.
Human, voice user, and browser agent operate on the same truth.
execution_rationale: The packet presents a clear search-to-shortlist-to-cart flow with accessibility and human confirmation; video and gallery evidence support a polished product surface.
execution_evidence: Three video frame sheets and six gallery images are provided.
Description specifies verified decision cards, voice path, and final shopper decision.
impact_rationale: It addresses hallucinated shopping recommendations and accessibility barriers for a broad set of shoppers, with a credible safer workflow.
impact_evidence: Concrete fabricated-headphones problem motivates the product.
Supports blind/low-vision, motor-limited, hands-free, and ordinary shoppers.
creativity_rationale: The combination of shared human/voice/agent shopping state, evidence-backed recommendations, and agency-preserving cart preparation is a strong synthesis.
creativity_evidence: Three actors use the same shopping experience through different modalities.
Voice-first accessibility is integrated into the WebMCP workflow.
usability_note: Decision cards and voice interaction appear intentionally designed, though live commerce integrations can add complexity.
standouts: Strong accessibility framing.
Safety and truthfulness are product mechanisms, not marketing claims.
advance_reason: Compelling impact and major WebMCP delta with a concrete, accessible workflow.

one_line: A policy control plane that protects WebMCP tool calls with data transformation, approvals, and posture rules.
what_it_does: Wraps imperative WebMCP functions, applies organization-defined privacy and access policies, and manages sensitive-data redaction/tokenization and human confirmation.
leverage_rationale: The SDK changes the trust boundary of WebMCP by enforcing policies at tool execution rather than asking agents to infer safety from UI controls.
leverage_evidence: SDK wrapper injects data protection and confirmation controls into WebMCP functions.
Token consistency lets agents reason across records without seeing raw sensitive values.
execution_rationale: The packet describes a credible SDK plus management console and multiple policy types, but demo_alive is unknown and end-to-end operation is less certain.
execution_evidence: Three video frame sheets and four gallery images are provided.
Description covers data protection, human confirmation, and posture assessment policies.
impact_rationale: Organizations exposing sensitive internal data to agents have a serious security and privacy need, and the approach preserves useful reasoning while limiting disclosure.
impact_evidence: Handles names, SSNs, credit cards, and health-record dates.
Supports approval before irreversible actions such as deletion.
creativity_rationale: The security-control-plane framing and privacy-preserving consistent tokens are a strong, practical extension of WebMCP, though policy gateways are an established category.
creativity_evidence: Contextual redaction and stable pseudonyms are designed for agent reasoning.
Posture assessment restricts agent classes rather than only user actions.
usability_note: Centralized policies can reduce application burden, but SDK integration and policy authoring may be complex.
standouts: Addresses a foundational WebMCP deployment barrier.
Privacy transformations preserve cross-record reasoning.
advance_reason: High-impact infrastructure with a meaningful WebMCP-specific security contribution.

one_line: A real-time Polish wedding-dance coach combining WebMCP, audio, vibration, and agent-led training.
what_it_does: Provides structured dance instruction, song/BPM recommendations, real-time state, and agent-orchestrated practice for the Szuraniec/2-on-1 dance.
leverage_rationale: An agent can retrieve exact methodology, inspect training state, and orchestrate a physical practice loop more reliably than a chatbot giving abstract advice.
leverage_evidence: Ten-tool suite spans knowledge, state, and action.
Description explicitly positions the agent as an autonomous pilot for training.
execution_rationale: The packet shows a focused trainer with real-time audio/vibration modalities and a complete tool suite; video evidence is present and demo is alive.
execution_evidence: Three video frame sheets and one gallery image are provided.
Web Audio and Web Vibration are integrated with the training interface.
impact_rationale: It serves a real cultural and social learning need, though the audience is specialized and the packet gives less evidence about training outcomes.
impact_evidence: Targets wedding guests learning a specific Polish dance.
Addresses the gap between text advice and physical muscle memory.
creativity_rationale: Turning an agent into a real-time physical dance coach with timing, audio, vibration, and cultural specificity is memorable and ambitious.
creativity_evidence: Agent-driven active coaching rather than conversational dance tips.
Combines WebMCP with browser sensory APIs for embodied practice.
usability_note: Multimodal feedback is promising for practice, but real-time coaching quality is not fully assessable from the packet.
standouts: Exceptional embodied use of WebMCP.
Strong cultural specificity without sacrificing clarity.
advance_reason: Highly creative, focused, and technically integrated agent-coaching concept.

one_line: An evidence-linked food verification layer that evaluates household rules without claiming food is simply safe.
what_it_does: Turns household dietary constraints into typed rules and checks products, menus, and meal plans against dated nutrition and allergen evidence with four explicit verdicts.
leverage_rationale: WebMCP provides a shared, evidence-bound verification surface where the agent can query rules and dated sources without guessing or collapsing uncertainty into a binary answer.
leverage_evidence: Agent operates in the open against source-and-date-backed records.
Unknown is an explicit verdict and the word safe is intentionally avoided.
execution_rationale: The packet reports a well-defined product, measured comparison against direct API and browser-agent baselines, and a coherent record workflow; video/gallery evidence is substantial.
execution_evidence: Three video frame sheets and seven gallery images are provided.
Timed comparison reports correct dated conflict in 1:21 with six actions and zero wrong turns.
Saved records are dated and handoff-ready.
impact_rationale: Food allergy and dietary-rule verification is a high-stakes, concrete need, and the product directly addresses evidence freshness and uncertainty.
impact_evidence: Milk allergy and sodium-under-200mg example with a documented 780mg conflict.
Targets families, schools, kitchens, restaurants, and agents.
creativity_rationale: The refusal-aware, four-verdict model and dated evidence handoff are unusually thoughtful responses to the failure mode of overconfident food answers.
creativity_evidence: Unknown counts as no and safe is never asserted.
Rules can cover a household, full menu, or week of meals.
usability_note: Plain-language rules, visible evidence, and honest verdicts support trust; high-stakes use still warrants careful user review.
standouts: Best evidence discipline in the packet.
High-stakes uncertainty is made operational rather than hidden.
advance_reason: Outstanding impact, leverage, and execution for a safety-critical audience.

one_line: A structured agent workspace for AI receptionist analytics, appointments, transcripts, and safe configuration publishing.
what_it_does: Exposes authenticated customer-portal operations for summaries, call search/details, appointments, configuration preview, and explicit publish.
leverage_rationale: Business operations become bounded, authenticated actions with scoped data and preview-before-publish safety instead of brittle multi-screen browser automation.
leverage_evidence: Seven private tools use authentication-derived scope.
Configuration changes require a field-level preview and separate short-lived publish ID.
execution_rationale: The packet specifies a realistic isolated judge account, fixture provider, tests, and a complete read/write workflow; video evidence is available and demo is alive.
execution_evidence: Three video frame sheets are provided.
Public repository includes contracts, lifecycle, fixture provider, tests, and runnable sanitized demo.
impact_rationale: Small businesses using AI receptionists have a clear need to understand calls and appointments and safely update live assistant configuration.
impact_evidence: Qualified-caller follow-up is a concrete cross-screen workflow.
Uses isolated fictional records and a disposable VAPI assistant for the demo.
creativity_rationale: The product is a strong, safety-conscious synthesis of CRM analytics and agent-controlled voice-assistant administration, though the business use case is familiar.
creativity_evidence: Preview-before-publish is applied to live receptionist configuration.
Combines transcripts, appointments, analytics, and settings in one agent surface.
usability_note: Bounded tools and preview workflow should reduce risk for operators; login/session setup remains a dependency.
standouts: Excellent authenticated read/write boundary.
Clear operational value for small businesses.
advance_reason: Strong product coherence and major WebMCP delta in a credible business workflow.

one_line: A probe harness that measures where WebMCP tool implementations accept inputs their schemas forbid.
what_it_does: Enumerates reference-demo tools, generates invalid and adversarial inputs, invokes them, and records schema-versus-runtime behavior.
leverage_rationale: WebMCP is the subject and measurement surface: structured tool schemas enable systematic conformance probing that ordinary UI automation cannot reproduce comparably.
leverage_evidence: Reads declared schemas and generates type, enum, bounds, required-field, length, and instruction-like violations.
Reports 17/17 tools accepting forbidden inputs and 225/289 probes.
execution_rationale: The scope is tightly defined and experimentally concrete, using unmodified official reference demos and a large probe matrix; video and gallery evidence support the reporting interface.
execution_evidence: Three video frame sheets and five gallery images are provided.
Vendored Apache-2.0 reference demos provide a reproducible target set.
Quantified probe results are stated in the packet.
impact_rationale: Schema enforcement gaps can cause unsafe or incorrect agent behavior; exposing the problem with reproducible evidence is valuable to WebMCP implementers and spec authors.
impact_evidence: Tests official Chrome WebMCP reference demos rather than toy failures.
Includes malicious-looking and malformed input classes.
creativity_rationale: The pivot from building a tool to empirically testing the promise-versus-runtime gap is sharp, surprising, and technically ambitious.
creativity_evidence: Systematic negative-input generation across 23 tools.
Targets a live specification debate and turns it into an observable product.
usability_note: Useful to implementers, though the probe workflow is specialized and findings may require engineering interpretation.
standouts: Exceptional empirical framing.
Concrete security and conformance relevance.
advance_reason: One of the clearest WebMCP-native developer tools, with unusually strong quantified evidence.

one_line: A source-linked MLPerf inference leaderboard for safe, exact-slice accelerator comparisons.
what_it_does: Lets humans and agents discover valid benchmark slices, configure visible filters, compare accelerator families, and inspect immutable source evidence.
leverage_rationale: Structured slice discovery and shared filter/comparison state reduce ambiguity and prevent agents from making universal claims from mismatched benchmark rows.
leverage_evidence: Four tools constrain comparisons to release, division, workload, scenario, target, metric, and unit.
Results include GitHub source URLs, hashes, and explicit missing-evidence reasons.
execution_rationale: The product has a deterministic pinned data pipeline, clear comparison workflow, and strong provenance design; video sheets provide product-motion evidence.
execution_evidence: Three video frame sheets are provided.
Normalized data is generated deterministically from a pinned MLPerf v6.0 commit.
Comparison supports 2–8 accelerator families.
impact_rationale: Researchers, engineers, and buyers need reliable hardware comparisons, and the product directly addresses common workload/unit/accuracy conflation.
impact_evidence: Targets official MLPerf Inference results.
Exact-slice constraints and source links address a real comparison failure mode.
creativity_rationale: The provenance-first agent/human leaderboard is a thoughtful and technically mature take on a known analytics category.
creativity_evidence: Agent changes the same visible filters humans see.
Missing evidence is surfaced instead of filled with invented numbers.
usability_note: Exact-slice controls improve trust, although benchmark terminology may be demanding for casual users.
standouts: Strong evidence provenance and comparison constraints.
Good human-agent shared-state design.
advance_reason: Credible, high-value research/data workflow with meaningful WebMCP safety improvements.

one_line: A local-first assisted design canvas where agents handle repetitive logo and asset operations.
what_it_does: Allows agents to create variations, organize local assets, adjust layouts, use local fonts, and save design progress to a local workspace.
leverage_rationale: Direct structured access to canvas state and local assets improves repeatability for click-heavy edits, but a capable UI agent could reproduce many outcomes with friction.
leverage_evidence: Description lists duplicate, recolor, resize, and reposition as agent operations.
Frame sheets show an assisted canvas with changing artwork and action/sidebar states.
execution_rationale: Video frames show a coherent canvas workflow progressing from blank artboard to generated illustrations and inserted media, but exact tool semantics are not always legible.
execution_evidence: Three video frame sheets show canvas states, assistant/action panel, and persistent results.
Devpost screenshot identifies a one-take hands-free demo.
impact_rationale: Designers have a genuine repetitive-production burden and local-first asset handling can be valuable, though the demonstrated scope appears lightweight.
impact_evidence: Targets logo variation, organization, layout, and handoff work.
Filesystem API keeps local assets in the user workspace.
creativity_rationale: The local workspace plus hands-free agent-assisted canvas is a fresh synthesis for designers, even though assisted design canvases are an established direction.
creativity_evidence: Local fonts and assets are part of the agent workflow.
Frame progression shows multiple illustration variants and a later media result.
usability_note: A simple canvas and visible actions are approachable; complex design fidelity is not demonstrated deeply.
standouts: Local-first asset model.
Clear delegation of repetitive design work.
advance_reason: Solid creative tool with credible product-motion evidence and a meaningful, if not transformative, WebMCP delta.

one_line: A local-first PDF study workspace where agents create attributable, undoable page annotations with the learner.
what_it_does: Opens PDFs, supports page navigation and selection, lets agents search/read/annotate, and keeps edits in the visual document workspace.
leverage_rationale: Page-local structured tools let agents act on the opened document and annotation state directly, improving precision over generic chat or UI driving.
leverage_evidence: Description exposes search, navigation, and custom annotation capabilities to the browser agent.
Viewed frame sheets show PDF pages, selection/highlighting, contextual panel, modal operation, and resulting marks.
execution_rationale: The video demonstrates a coherent upload/open, navigate, select, invoke, and annotate workflow; exact end-state semantics are somewhat difficult to read at frame-sheet scale.
execution_evidence: Three video frame sheets show landing/upload, PDF workspace, text selection, modal/tool interaction, and edited states.
Devpost packaging describes attributable and undoable edits.
impact_rationale: Researchers, students, lawyers, and other visual learners have a real need for reliable PDF annotation and search without losing document context.
impact_evidence: Targets reading papers and lecture notes with annotations and mind maps.
Local-first operation addresses crashes, RAM bloat, and weak annotation search in the stated prior workflow.
creativity_rationale: The human-and-agent co-reading model, with page-local markup, attribution, and undo, is a thoughtful extension beyond PDF chat summarization.
creativity_evidence: Agent marks up the page alongside the human rather than only answering questions.
Annotation provenance and reversibility are core interaction properties.
usability_note: Document-centric visual feedback and undo support the intended learner workflow; broader PDF compatibility is not established.
standouts: Strong shared human-agent document state.
Annotation attribution and undo are excellent trust features.
advance_reason: Clear, useful research/education workflow with strong visual evidence and a substantial WebMCP contribution.
